evidence.note: Entry-area closet door is closed before manipulation.
User's hand is on the handle and begins opening the door.
Closet door is open, exposing hanging clothes and shoes.
User grasps the door while closing it.
Door is fully closed again.
Microwave door is closed.
User reaches to the microwave handle/control area.
Microwave door is open.
Microwave remains open.
User pushes the door toward the appliance.
Microwave door is closed.
Oven door is closed.
User pulls the oven handle and the door begins descending.
Oven door is fully open.
Oven remains open.
User lifts the oven door toward the closed position.
Oven door is closed.
Dishwasher front is closed as the user reaches toward it.
Dishwasher door is open and its racks are visible.
Dishwasher remains open.
User lifts the dishwasher door closed.
Dishwasher is fully closed.
Both leaves of the upper cabinet above the sink are closed.
User reaches to the center seam; the first leaf begins opening.
At least one cabinet leaf is open.
Both cabinet leaves are visibly open.
The leaves are being closed in rapid succession.
Both leaves are closed.

events.object_description: Upper cabinet above sink, right-hand door leaf

evidence.note: Upper cabinet begins the two-leaf opening sequence.
The first leaf is open while the second leaf's exact state is difficult to distinguish.
Both cabinet leaves are visibly open.
Both leaves remain open.
One leaf appears closed while the other is being finished.
Both leaves are closed.

events.object_description: Upper cabinet above sink, left-hand door leaf

evidence.note: Lower drawer beside the refrigerator is closed.
User pulls the drawer front.
Drawer is open, exposing stored boxes and cloths.
Drawer remains open.
Drawer is closed again.
Upper refrigerator compartment is closed.
User pulls the upper refrigerator handle.
Upper refrigerator door is open and the illuminated interior is visible.
Refrigerator remains open.
User pushes the upper door closed.
Upper refrigerator door is fully closed.
Lower freezer door is closed.
User pulls the lower handle.
Lower freezer door is open and freezer drawers are visible.
Freezer remains open.
User pushes the lower door closed.
Lower freezer door is fully closed.
Laundry-closet door is closed.
Door has been opened, revealing the stacked washer and dryer.
Laundry closet remains open.
User grasps the handle and swings the door closed.
Laundry-closet door is fully closed.

notes: Ten movable-part episodes are reported. The two hinged leaves of the upper cabinet above the sink are counted separately because both are visibly open after a rapid manipulation sequence; their individual transition ordering is less certain than the other events.
scene_description: A user traverses a studio apartment and sequentially opens and closes a coat closet, microwave, oven, dishwasher, two upper-cabinet leaves, a lower drawer, the refrigerator and freezer doors, and a laundry-closet door.
